summaryDeep:
This connection can heat up fast. You may find that this person gets a reaction out of you before either of you fully understands what is happening. At times, you might feel like they know exactly how to push your buttons, while they may feel like you are reacting before they have a chance to explain themselves. There can be a strong attraction here, but there can also be irritation. The challenge is learning how to work with that energy instead of letting it take over every interaction.

At its best, this makes the connection feel alive. You may push each other to be more honest, more direct, or less passive. Things probably do not feel boring between you. There is enough charge here that both people stay tuned in.

The harder part is when friction becomes the main way the relationship gets attention. If the two of you only feel connected when something is tense, the relationship can start running on conflict instead of care. What began as chemistry can turn into a habit of poking at each other and calling it passion.

Not every reaction needs a response. Not every little thing has to become a whole thing.
